title: ROS 2 parameters
keywords: parameter parameters param yaml params-file declare get set dump ros__parameters
text: Parameters are per-node settings (bool, int, double, string and arrays) that a node declares and can change at runtime. ros2 param list, ros2 param get /node name, ros2 param set and ros2 param dump /node inspect them; --ros-args --params-file params.yaml loads a file at startup. In the YAML file the top-level key is the node name (or /** for every node) followed by ros__parameters. A parameter that seems to do nothing is often set on the wrong node name or namespace, or never declared by the node.
